records.statement: Let $H_z$ be the regular four-row constraint/gauge horizontal map, let $G_z$ be the positive source-coframe phase metric, and assume $H_zG_z^{-1}H_z^{\mathsf T}$ is nonsingular. The physical tangent projector is \begin{equation} P_z=I-G_z^{-1}H_z^{\mathsf T} \left(H_zG_z^{-1}H_z^{\mathsf T}\right)^{-1}H_z. \label{eq:moving-projector} \end{equation} At the flat anchor it has configuration rank two and phase rank four, kills all four constraint/gauge directions, is symplectic on its image, and splits the eight-dimensional constraint surface into four gauge plus four physical dimensions.
